<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="button" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A06AF9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FBA3FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="5" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#200E32" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="21" x2="315" y2="27" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="19" x2="320" y2="27" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="17" x2="325" y2="27" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="25" x2="346" y2="28" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="353" y="17" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="356" y="20" width="15" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#200745"/>
    <rect x="376" y="20" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#200745"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top navigation -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,62 24,69 31,76" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="69" x2="42" y2="69" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="75" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#200745">Order complete</text>
  </g>

  <!-- success illustration -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="92" fill="#F5F0FF"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="68" fill="url(#bg)"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="54" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".96"/>
    <polyline points="165,190 185,210 226,166" fill="none" stroke="#6EA95C" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="121" cy="116" r="7" fill="#FFDD72"/>
    <circle cx="271" cy="137" r="6" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
    <circle cx="286" cy="224" r="8" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <circle cx="112" cy="248" r="5" fill="#A06AF9"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="324" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#200745">Thank you, Maya!</text>
  <text x="195" y="352" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Your order has been placed successfully.</text>
  <text x="195" y="376" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">We’ll send updates to maya.johnson@email.com</text>

  <!-- order details card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="408" width="342" height="154" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="44" y="440" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Order details</text>
    <rect x="44" y="455" width="302" height="1" fill="#E7E7E7"/>
    <text x="44" y="483" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Order number</text>
    <text x="346" y="483" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">#KH-24891</text>
    <text x="44" y="510" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Estimated delivery</text>
    <text x="346" y="510" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Tue, Jul 30</text>
    <text x="44" y="537" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Total paid</text>
    <text x="346" y="537" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">$86.40</text>
  </g>

  <!-- status chip -->
  <g>
    <rect x="127" y="585" width="136" height="30" rx="15" fill="#EAF8E7"/>
    <circle cx="143" cy="600" r="4" fill="#6EA95C"/>
    <text x="153" y="605" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#4A8641">Payment confirmed</text>
  </g>

  <!-- primary action -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="650" width="342" height="52" rx="26" fill="url(#button)"/>
    <text x="195" y="683" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Back to home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- secondary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="714" width="342" height="44" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="742" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">View order details</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="780" x2="390" y2="780" stroke="#E7E7E7" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,800 50,791 61,800 61,811 53,811 53,803 47,803 47,811 39,811" fill="#200745"/>
      <text x="50" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#200745">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="128" cy="800" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="128,795 128,800 132,803" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="128" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Orders</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="185" y="792" width="20" height="15" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="185,796 195,802 205,796" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="204" cy="791" r="4" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
      <text x="195" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Messages</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="274" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="274" cy="794" r="2.5" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <ellipse cx="274" cy="803" rx="5" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="274" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="348" cy="799" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="348" y1="794" x2="348" y2="804" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="343" y1="799" x2="353" y2="799" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="348" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Help</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
